title: Longest block that sums to zero
description: Return the length of the longest block of consecutive elements of the list whose sum is exactly 0. A single element 0 is a block of length 1. If no block sums to 0 (including the empty list), return 0. Values may be negative.
notes: Prefix sums: a block is zero-sum when two prefix totals are equal; the earliest occurrence of each total gives the longest block. Includes whole-list blocks, overlapping candidates and totals that return to 0 several times.
